about: An inventory of unresolved source markers outside tests, generated data and fixtures. Each entry records its source path and, when available, the filed research question that would settle it. A marker on the money or law path remains unavailable for play until evidence resolves it. A null researchQuestionId records that no question has been filed; researchQuestionFiled records whether docs/research/requests contains the named question. scripts/research/placeholder-scan.ts lists search matches that are not game values and records why they are excluded.
pathRule: money covers files whose values reach pay, prices, balances or public money; law covers files that make, number, decide, enact or apply law, or seat the bodies that do; government covers elections, candidacies, offices and the press; other covers everything else. scripts/research/placeholder-scan.ts assigns the category by file.
